notes: Never checked the naked Server 1 that held Project Beale for three turns, then spent most later turns clicking for credits at 10-20 credits with nothing to spend on. Also ran the unstealable Degree Mill four times in one turn and never trashed Marilyn or Commercial Bankers Group.
Solid scoring plan with good economy, but both Global Food Initiatives sat behind nothing but Pop-up Window against a rich Runner. Installing a second Sensie Actors Union as a remote card was odd.

Spent everything on Engolo turn 1, then facechecked Loki and Anemone at 0 credits. From turn 6 it only clicked for credits up to 28 and never ran the remote where the Corp installed and scored three agendas.

Sensible iced remote scoring, but several mid-game turns were spent clicking for credits at 16-19 credits and drawing into discards instead of pushing agendas faster. The passive Runner never punished it.

Won a 29-turn game against a Corp stuck at 1 credit for ages; it kept hitting Turnpike on HQ for tags it then paid to clear and re-ran HQ into known cards. Played Indexing twice without following up with an R&D run, and left R&D mostly alone until very late.

Clicked for credits for six straight turns up to 26 credits while discarding every turn, never installing the Fast Tracked GFI or anything else. Agendas piled up in an open Archives, and Audacity dumped HQ there to hand the Runner the win.

Good Account Siphon and HQ pressure plus clever Forged Activation Orders to drain the Corp. But it hoarded 30-40 credits while the Corp scored small agendas from Server 1, and Bank Job was installed twice and never used.
After trashing a few early assets it clicked for credits every turn up to 63 credits and installed no programs. It never contested the remotes where four agendas were installed and advanced.

Early turns were spent clicking for credits with a full hand and discarding, which put Accelerated Beta Test and Efficiency Committee into an open Archives for the Runner to steal. Another Efficiency Committee was lost behind a single Eli; later scoring was fine.
Strong Blue Sun Mausolus loop that taxed and damaged the Runner every turn while SDS Drone Deployments scored safely. Advancing was a bit slow, and the final Hostile Takeover sat in a naked remote.
IP Block held the main remote cleanly, but Project Beale sat in a completely unprotected Server 2 for nine turns, and scoring was slow on a thin economy. The Runner's looping made this unpunished.

Overdrew and discarded cards in the early turns and stayed passive while the Corp built a remote. Then it Stimhacked into unrezzed HQ ice against a Blue Sun Corp holding 13 credits with only 4 cards in grip, and was flatlined by Chiyashi plus Stimhack damage.

Spent turns 5-13 clicking for credits up to 30 and discarding every turn while holding Project Beale and Bellona in an HQ with only IP Block. The Runner took both in one run; later remote scoring behind Enigma was fine.
Early R&D pressure got it to 5 points, but it never once ran Server 1, a single-ice remote that the Corp used to score four agendas. Late turns went to tag removal and clicking for credits.
Effective R&D Interface and Temujin pressure plus timely HQ runs kept the Corp broke and won steadily. It played Indexing without a follow-up and kept reinstalling cards that Archangel bounced.

Playing Audacity on turn 1 to bin the whole hand was bizarre, and the Corp never recovered from 0-4 credits. It held GFI in a lightly iced HQ and reinstalled Project Atlas behind the Border Control the Runner had already broken.

Siphons plus Femme Fatale on Resistor locked the Corp at 0 credits, but the Runner then made many repeat HQ runs into known cards. It ignored R&D, whose ice the broke Corp could not rez, and the game dragged to turn 17.
Short game in which the Corp built credits and rezzed Chiyashi and Mlinzi at the right moments to flatline the Runner. Divert Power on turn 1 with nothing to derez wasted a click and 2 credits.

Scored efficiently with a fast Breaking News and a SanSan City Grid finish, but Project Beale and GFI were advanced behind only Pop-up Window against a Runner with 14-30 credits. Economy hovered near zero mid-game.
Clicked for credits every turn up to 44 without installing a single card. It made one run all game while the Corp installed and scored three agendas from Server 2.
